title: spex-build recipe (recipe.json)
description: M72 — a site as a small JSON document composing real, grid-legal parametric brick primitives. Read by `spex build <recipe.json> -o <out.ldr>` (crates/spex-cli/src/build_cmd.rs), which calls crates/spex-build's real recipe.rs pipeline. Each step names one real primitive from crates/spex-build/src/primitives.rs (Wall, Column, Arch, Stair, Ziggurat, Pyramid, Dome, Trilithon, Colonnade, Mosaic) and a `params` object matching that primitive's own fields (camelCase). `color` fields (a primitive's own `color`, or a palette entry's own colour) accept either a real LDraw colour code (integer) or a name looked up in this document's own `palette`. See docs/fugen/phase4-kit.md's M72 section for the full spec and each primitive's real field names.

id.description: Stable slug, e.g. "stonehenge". Carried into the emitted .ldr's own `0 Author:` provenance line.

scale.description: Stated, not implied — every recipe declares its own real-world scale.

palette.description: Named real LDraw colour codes, so a recipe's steps can say "stone" instead of repeating a bare integer.

knownIllegal.description: Real, justified exceptions to what `validate()` finds (M72 acceptance criterion 2). Each entry names a real placement index (0-based, in the order this recipe's steps and their arranged instances emit them) and why it is intentionally off-grid, overlapping, non-axis-rotated, or floating. `spex build` prints these separately from any undeclared problem.

primitive.description: One of the real primitives crates/spex-build/src/primitives.rs implements.

count.description: How many instances of this primitive to emit. count > 1 requires arrangeOn — every instance would otherwise land on the same placement, which spex-build rejects rather than silently overlapping.

params.description: The named primitive's own real fields, camelCase (e.g. Wall: widthStuds, heightPlates, depthStuds, bond, color; Column: heightPlates, diameterStuds, color). See docs/fugen/phase4-kit.md's M72 section for every primitive's real field names, and crates/spex-build/src/recipe.rs's build_primitive for the authoritative mapping.

arrangeOn.description: Lays `count` instances of one step's primitive around a real arc or circle, evenly spaced. Each instance's orientation is snapped to whichever of the real 24 axis-aligned orientations is closest to facing outward along the radius — see crates/spex-build/src/recipe.rs's arc_point doc comment for the exact, documented approximation (a placement's own origin is its front-bottom-left corner, not its centre, so a ring of primitives sits about half a footprint off the ideal circle).

at.description: A fixed single placement for a step with no arrangeOn (defaults to the recipe's own origin, identity orientation, when absent). Not in phase4-kit.md's own minimal example recipe, but needed by any real recipe composing more than one differently positioned primitive — additive, every recipe that omits it behaves exactly as documented.

orientationDeg.description: Snapped to the nearest of the real 24 axis-aligned orientations' yaw.
